from itertools import product

def featurize(P, out, bg):
    rows=[]
    # grid-level counts
    counts={k:len(v) for k,v in P.items()}
    cnts=list(counts.values())
    from collections import Counter as C
    mode=C(cnts).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for k,cells in P.items():
        n=len(cells)
        f={}
        f['count']=n; f['ismode']=int(n==mode); f['cnt_minus_mode']=n-mode
        cols=[c for r,c in cells]; rws=[r for r,c in cells]
        samecol = len(set(cols))<n
        samerow = len(set(rws))<n
        if n==2:
            d=abs(cells[0][0]-cells[1][0])+abs(cells[0][1]-cells[1][1])
            f['dist']=d
            f['samecol_gap']=(cells[0][1]==cells[1][1] and abs(cells[0][0]-cells[1][0])>=2)
            f['samecol_adj']=(cells[0][1]==cells[1][1] and abs(cells[0][0]-cells[1][0])==1)
        else:
            f['dist']=-1; f['samecol_gap']=False; f['samecol_adj']=False
        f['mark']=int(out[k]!=bg)
        f['key']=k
        rows.append(f)
    return rows

# candidate literals
def lit(f,name):
    return {

    }[name]
lits=['ismode','!ismode','cnt>mode','cnt<mode','samecol_gap','samecol_adj','count2','count1','!(count2 & !samecol_gap)']

def grid_cells(G, special):  # all special cells
    return [(r,c) for r in range(G.shape[0]) for c in range(G.shape[1]) if G[r,c]==special]

def feats_for(P, G, cells_all, O, bg):
    H,W = G.shape
    rowsout=[]
    rowcount = Counter(r for r,c in cells_all)
    colcount = Counter(c for r,c in cells_all)
    for k,cells in P.items():
        n=len(cells)
        f={}
        f['count']=n
        # edge-inert count: cells in col0/lastcol/row0/lastrow ignored
        f['count_ei']=sum(1 for r,c in cells if 0<r<H-1 and 0<c<W-1)
        f['has_edge']=int(f['count_ei']!=n)
        f['mark']=int(O[k]!=bg)
        f['key']=k
        # line features: cell in a row/col with >=3 cells, or pair spacing<=2 same col
        f['row3']=int(any(rowcount[r]>=3 for r,c in cells))
        f['col3']=int(any(colcount[c]>=3 for r,c in cells))
        cols=[c for r,c in cells]
        f['samecol']=int(len(set(cols))<n and n==2)
        f['sp2']=int(n==2 and cols[0]==cols[1] and abs(cells[0][0]-cells[1][0])==2)
        rowsout.append(f)
    return rowsout
